title: Longest Substring Without Repeats
hints: Sliding window: remember where each character was last seen.
When a repeated character appears inside the window, move the window start just past its previous position.
`if let prev = lastSeen[ch], prev >= start { start = prev + 1 }; lastSeen[ch] = i; best = max(best, i - start + 1)`.
jsBridge: Sliding window + `[Character: Int]` of last positions. In Swift, walk `Array(s)` for integer indices, because `String` indices aren't integers. Emoji then count as single characters for free.

compass.q: Your JS solution with `s[i]` breaks on emoji. Why does converting to `[Character]` fix it in Swift?
